name: daytona
summary: I successfully installed the Daytona Python SDK (v0.204.0) and created sandboxes via the SDK, as demonstrated by real output showing `Sandbox created with ID: f5eeaa05-b15c-4867-9c81-cfd3616bafb6` with state `SandboxState.STARTED`. I also verified via direct API call that sandbox creation works and returns a valid sandbox object with ID `bbd1979b-06d2-48a2-8fc2-1accef14a186`. However, I was blocked from completing the promised outcome because executing code inside the sandbox requires connecting to the toolbox proxy at `proxy.app.daytona.io`, which consistently failed with `ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer')`—a network-level block preventing any command execution inside the created sandbox.

env_ready.evidence: pip install --upgrade daytona completed with exit=0 and pip show daytona reported Version: 0.204.0

installed.evidence: pip show daytona | grep Version returned Version: 0.204.0 and which daytona found /usr/local/bin/daytona

configured.evidence: export DAYTONA_API_URL="https://app.daytona.io/api" && export DAYTONA_TARGET="us" && python inspect_sandbox.py successfully returned a sandbox ID and state

first_call.evidence: python inspect_sandbox.py printed Sandbox ID: e77bd322-260e-48b4-ae96-6065b5836870 and Sandbox state: SandboxState.STARTED

verified.evidence: Attempt 1 failed: Failed to execute command: ('Connection aborted.', ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer')) — repeated for all exec attempts with no observed command output from inside the sandbox
